title: Compare MapLibre GL JS in an isolated sandbox
acceptanceCriteria: Sandbox opens independently from the working driver app.
No production endpoints, spreadsheet IDs, Apps Script writers, Ride Requests writer, or live rider data exist in the sandbox.
Deterministic route geometry renders after the MapLibre map loads.
Load time, approximate FPS, supported memory usage, and map failures are surfaced for comparison.
Destroy stops the metrics animation loop and removes the map.
Hoy Driver remains on the existing Leaflet baseline with no MapLibre code introduced into its Index.html.
FEATURE_MAPLIBRE remains false outside this isolated sandbox.
Forge CI passes before merge; no automatic merge or deployment occurs.
